usage.outputShape: body.image_url (signed PNG download URL), body.format, body.file_size_bytes, body.source_url, body.job_id
quirks: inputSchema was null in the registry — the correct body field is {url} (full URL incl. https://); inferred and verified working
Response is synchronous (200) even though it returns a job_id — no polling needed; the screenshot is already rendered
body.image_url is a TEMPORARY signed CloudConvert S3 URL (X-Amz-Expires=86400, ~24h). Download/re-host the PNG immediately; the link expires.
Image is NOT returned inline; you must fetch body.image_url separately to get the PNG bytes
usage.guide: POST to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/website-screenshot with JSON body {"url":"https://example.com"} (full URL including scheme). Pay $0.04 USDC on Base via x402. The response is synchronous JSON 200 — read body.image_url to get a signed PNG download link, then fetch that URL to obtain the actual screenshot bytes. The signed link expires in ~24h, so download or re-host it promptly. Despite a job_id field in the response, no polling is required.
